svg.title: zmylol - a small book of useful spells
svg.desc: A pause on the original hero party's journey: Frieren studies a small spell, while Himmel checks the map and Heiter and Eisen wait by a signpost. This banner and the Himmel avatar are crops of the same panorama. AI agents, native apps, local-first tools.

g.text: A SMALL BOOK OF USEFUL SPELLS
